message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the loaded data; the code simply passes columns and parameters directly without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched via the wrds library with a hardcoded username but no checksum verification, signed URLs, or integrity checks are performed on the retrieved data.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code applies StandardScaler and loads data but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch (via `main()` and classifier specifications) and loads only configuration JSON; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, and no hash/signature verification is performed anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, verifies expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or custom DP mechanisms are imported or used in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no hashing, signing, or cryptographic verification of evaluation data; while a train/test split exists, there is no explicit mechanism to enforce isolation or detect metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads data directly via load_full_data() and passes it to the model pipeline without any input shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model outputs (e.g., probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation) are visible in the inference data-flow path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models used are classical ML/LSTM classifiers for financial data, not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
